purpose: Preserve independent source evidence used to resolve user-facing identities for exact-serial catalog collisions without collapsing distinct package, component, scale, or catalog records.

records.resolution_note: Independent historical catalog evidence maps GH0114 to Cassie Lang / Stinger. The two current HeroBloks Wasp records remain preserved as conflicting catalog observations rather than replacing the user release identity.

sources.evidence: The G/GH catalog list assigns GH0114 to Cassie Lang / Stinger and GH0115 to Wasp.
The release preview independently associates GH0114 with Cassie Lang / Stinger.

records.resolution_note: Source evidence identifies XP-506 as the Denji/Chainsaw Man release with Pochita included, explaining separate HeroBloks entries under the same serial.

sources.evidence: HeroBloks identifies XP-506 as Chainsaw Man, basenames it Denji, and notes that it is with Pochita.
Retailer listing identifies the Denji with Pochita product as SKU XP506.

records.resolution_note: Source evidence identifies XP-508 as a Denji/Chainsaw Man release with Pochita included, explaining separate HeroBloks entries under the same serial.

sources.evidence: Retailer listing identifies Bloody Chainsaw Man Denji with Pochita as SKU XP508.
HeroBloks records Pochita as a companion/catalog identity within the Koruit Chainsaw Man serial family and lists XP-508 among related versions.

policy: Evidence resolves only the user-facing release association supported by the cited sources. Conflicting catalog rows and package/component relationships stay explicit and provenance-bearing.
